question: At what eye frame rate, pitch speed and ball size is the pitch visible early enough to act on?

criteria.V1_visible: at least one frame with a pixel changing by >= 8
criteria.V2_frames: >= 8 detectable frames before the swing must start (contact - 35 ms swing - 10 ms latency)
criteria.V3_expansion: >= 3 distinct detected-pixel counts in that window
criteria.V4_budget: eye rendering <= 50% of a 0.64 s episode
